title: Building Code of Pakistan 2021
organization: Pakistan Engineering Council / Building Code of Pakistan
notes: BCP 2021 establishes the plumbing-code framework and identifies IPC-21 as a referenced code. AHJ applicability remains controlling.

title: 2021 International Plumbing Code
notes: Use the 2021 edition because BCP Chapter 34 identifies IPC-21. Only the sections relevant to PumpDesign AI are represented in this RAG package.

title: Updated Design Criteria for Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage System in Punjab
organization: Punjab Public Health Engineering Department / Government of Punjab
notes: Publicly accessible copy found online. Treat as provisional until an official Government of Punjab/PHED copy is supplied. Intended primarily for public water-supply systems, not automatically for internal building plumbing.
applicability_note: The document contains separate Water Supply, Sewerage and Drainage sections. Retrieval must use system/topic metadata so sewerage criteria are not mixed into water-supply calculations.

title: WASA Lahore Design Criteria (historical reference mentioned in Punjab 2023 criteria)
notes: The 2023 Punjab criteria states that the older WASA Lahore criterion used 80 GPCD but does not recommend continuing to apply that value universally. This is not an active PumpDesign AI design criterion.
applicability_note: Historical/context-only source; not an automatic current design criterion.

title: 2023 ASHRAE Handbook—HVAC Applications, Chapter 51: Service Water Heating
notes: Used for hot-water recirculation purpose, controls, heat-loss-based circulation flow sizing, pipe sizing considerations and pump head selection workflow.
